links.outcome: Head-to-head AUC comparison of candidate foundation models on same ocular and systemic disease tasks
links.effect: DINOv2-Large DR AUCs 0.850-0.952 vs RETFound 0.823-0.944 (all P≤0.007); RETFound better for systemic incidence prediction (AUC 0.796 HF, 0.732 MI, 0.754 stroke vs DINOv2 0.663-0.771, P<0.001).
links.quote: Conversely, for systemic disease incidence prediction, RETFound achieved superior AUCs of 0.796 (heart failure), 0.732 (myocardial infarction), and 0.754 (ischemic stroke), outperforming DINOv2's best models' AUC (0.663-0.771, all P < 0.001).

unlisted_practices: Aligning foundation model selection (general-purpose vs domain-specific) with task-specific requirements

screen.reason: Empirical head-to-head benchmarking of natural image vs retina-specific foundation models across ocular and systemic disease tasks using public datasets and UK Biobank, evaluating diagnostic performance without testing a clinical deployment practice.
